solutions.title: Memoized DFS over source indices
solutions.strategy: Recursively try taking the next target character from either source and memoize the consumed-length pair.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each pair of indices in the two source strings is evaluated once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The memo table stores source-index pairs, plus recursion depth.

solutions.title: 2D reachability DP
solutions.strategy: Let dp[i][j] say whether prefixes of lengths i and j can form the target prefix of length i+j.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every prefix-pair cell is filled once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: All prefix-pair reachability states are stored.

solutions.title: 1D rolling DP
solutions.strategy: Compress the 2D table so dp[j] represents the current row's reachability for j consumed characters from the second source.

timeComplexity.explanation: The same grid of prefix pairs is evaluated.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only one row over the second source is retained.
